jobs.title: Summer Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Apply online for RBI Summer Placement 2026. Get ₹25,000 stipend, AC II Tier rail reimbursement, and central banking experience. Check eligibility and apply by Dec 15.

About the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)

The Reserve Bank of India is India’s central banking institution, responsible for regulating the monetary policy, financial system, and currency supply of the nation. Operating through its Central Office in Mumbai and regional Control Offices across states and Union Territories, the RBI maintains financial stability and fosters economic growth. Undertaking an internship at RBI allows students to experience central banking operations, monetary research, and policy formulation firsthand.

Key Highlights of RBI Summer Internship 2026

ParameterOfficial Details
OrganizationReserve Bank of India (RBI)
Program NameRBI Summer Placement 2026
Total SeatsMaximum of 200 trainees selected annually
Monthly Stipend₹25,000 per month (w.e.f. April 2027 cycle)
Travel AllowanceReturn AC II Tier rail fare reimbursement for outstation trainees
Internship DurationUp to 3 months (April to July)
Application WindowOctober 15 to December 15
Selection MonthInterview: Jan–Feb | Selection list: Feb–March
Official Websiteopportunities.rbi.org.in

Eligibility Criteria for Applicants

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must be Indian citizens studying in recognized colleges or universities within India. Applicants must be enrolled in one of the following qualifications:

Postgraduate Courses: Management, Statistics, Commerce, Economics, Econometrics, Banking, or Finance.

Integrated Five-Year Courses: 5-year integrated programs in relevant disciplines or Law.

Law Stream: 3-year full-time professional Bachelor’s degree in Law (LL.B) or 5-year integrated Law program.

2. Year of Study

  • Candidates must be in their penultimate year (second-to-last year) of their respective course as on the date of application.

RBI Regional Control Offices & Allocation

Candidates must apply to the specific RBI Control Office that corresponds to the state or Union Territory where their institute is located.

Stipend, Travel Reimbursement & Facilities

Monthly Stipend: Trainees receive a stipend of ₹25,000 per month.

Travel Expenses: Selected outstation candidates are reimbursed AC II Tier return train fare (or equivalent amount) between their institution’s location and the internship centre.

Accommodation: Outstation trainees are required to arrange their own accommodation during the placement period.

Secrecy Declaration: Trainees must sign a formal Declaration of Secrecy with the Bank before joining.

Selection Process & Internship Duration

Shortlisting: Applications are reviewed by the respective Control Offices based on declared academic credentials.

Interview: Shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview in January or February at the respective RBI office. Outstation candidates bear their own travel costs for attending the interview.

Final Result: Selected candidate names are declared in February or March. Up to 200 candidates are chosen across India.

Duration: Placements run for up to 3 months, spanning from April to July.
